purpose: Authored restricted Snapshot C07 policy; actual compiler projections must match this reviewed structural allowlist. Runtime semantics are explicit policy, not inferred from TypeScript syntax.

testSaveCalls.lifetime: JS wrapper retaining actual KSP function references, no additional native owner; original Runtime controls close; stale invocation gates before retired descriptor access

testSettleProbe.lifetime: Runtime-owned one-shot until actual settler-return hook or close/fail; synchronous void invocation does not imply call-scope retention

notes: Public contract derives actual Kotlin public Boundary exported syntax; actual KSP facts/record schema are the managed implementation authority.
TypeScript number does not imply Int32; this explicit policy assigns Snapshot.value Int32 and text strict bounded UTF-8.
Managed allocation and paired cleanup follow the sole Kotlin owner and checked akinterop path; no C provider pointer ownership is inferred.
No business Promise cancellation from garbage collection or dropping wait.
State capacity_items=3 bounds one pending, one entered, and one staging reservation per selected subscription; all staging copies count in the shared 4096 retained UTF-8 budget.
Callback context_owner=subscription-owner describes the persistent listener registration. keep_alive=source-lease describes in-flight producer/delivery retention until lawful callback exit/drop.
Logical erased error channel ArkTSError admits unmodified user Error as well as BoundaryError. Actual BoundaryError.code declaration stays in the compiler descriptor; no exhaustive enum is inferred.
calling_convention=system is a logical backend convention; actual KSP/compiler facts and managed bootstrap evidence remain separate.
Stream classification comes from this explicit policy; TypeScript AST supplies method/callback signatures and Promise return syntax, not stream lifecycle semantics.

State capacity_items counts retained version responsibilities, not a public queue depth: latest pending remains one slot, entered callback and pre-commit staging have distinct owners. All count in the shared 4096-byte budget.
Shared resource self/return slots are backend reference handles whose explicit close belongs to the public owner. The erased ArkTSError channel is owned by ArkTS and is not a closable SDK resource.
Each call carries an authored stable public_id. SourceKey and API shape remain independently compiler-derived; retaining an ID across an explicit rename does not assert shape compatibility.
SavedCalls retains actual generated JavaScript function references without allocating another native owner. Runtime remains the lifecycle owner; stale and retired calls exercise actual native gates.
The one-shot settlement hook is retained by its checked Runtime until invocation or close/fail. Synchronous callback return does not imply call-scoped retention.
Diagnostic CSV values preserve full integer identity strings and UINT64_MAX unknown sentinels. Observations are bounded windows, not an unbounded cumulative counter guarantee.
Native memory metrics exclude Kotlin managed heap, VM memory, allocator overhead and RSS; original retired wrapper listener state is pure JavaScript and not a GC claim.

error_channel.meaning: Backend-owned erased ArkTS exception channel, including ordinary BoundaryError(code) and unmodified user Error. Not a finite error enum or an explicitly closable SDK owner.

scope: Restricted Snapshot test profile: actual KSP23 managed declarations and actual public facade; independent ordinary15 profile remains separate.
